heading: Get in Touch
intro: To schedule a consultation or ask a question about services, please call or email during business hours.
privacy_note: Do not send clinical or personal health information via email or through this website. For urgent matters, please call the office directly. If you are experiencing a mental health emergency, call 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or go to your nearest emergency room.
disclaimer: This website is for informational purposes only and does not constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. The content is not intended to be a substitute for professional clinical judgment. If you are in crisis, please call 988 or go to your nearest emergency department.
